evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected sealed reference adapter metadata, its declared Deserialize slot and void/Reader/original-output ABI, reciprocal generic parameter ownership, base-parent substitution, exact eager allocation and constructor argument order, and independently authenticated current source/control programs.
evidenceBoundary.direct: The selected positive array program forwards the same Reader and indexed original reference output through the provider receiver's virtual slot; the nominal closed signature is joined to that transfer without substituting a live receiver.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: The abstract base slot encoding is retained as a selected metadata word and is not interpreted as a native callback entry.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Previously owned abstract-adapter and union-false paths retain their stated initialization, ordinary return, buffer and runtime class/context selection conditions.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Actual provider/cache candidate, inflated receiver vtable and MethodInfo/shared pointer selection, callback cursor equality, positive list/root admission, refill/error behavior, and observed execution/effects. Lack of a unique closed compiled registration does not prove lack of runtime inflation.
